Inside a code span it is literal: https://example.com/a.

Inside a link's text it is literal too: https://example.com/b.

Mid-token it never fires: ahttps://example.com/c and x=https://example.com/d.

Other schemes never fire: ftp://example.com, www.example.com, a@example.com.

https://example.com/in-a-fence
